compositions.label: Rule of thirds
compositions.def: the subject placed a third of the way into the frame rather than dead centre.

compositions.label: Centred composition
compositions.def: the subject placed squarely in the middle of the frame for a formal, symmetrical feel.

compositions.label: Fill the frame
compositions.def: the subject enlarged to crowd out almost all background, leaving no empty space.

compositions.label: Negative space
compositions.def: a small subject surrounded by large areas of empty sky, wall or ground.

compositions.label: Frame within a frame
compositions.def: the subject seen through a doorway, window or arch that frames it.

compositions.label: Rule of odds
compositions.def: an odd number of subjects — often three — grouped for a pleasing arrangement.

compositions.label: Leading lines
compositions.def: roads, rails or fences that draw the eye into the picture.

compositions.label: Vanishing point
compositions.def: parallel lines converging to a single point deep in the frame.

compositions.label: Diagonal composition
compositions.def: a dominant slanting line running corner to corner for energy.

compositions.label: Symmetry
compositions.def: the two halves of the frame mirroring one another.

compositions.label: Pattern & repetition
compositions.def: a repeating motif — windows, arches, crowds — filling the frame.

compositions.label: S-curve
compositions.def: a sinuous S-shaped line — a river or path — winding through the scene.

compositions.label: Triangular composition
compositions.def: the main elements arranged into a stable triangle.

compositions.label: Bird’s-eye view
compositions.def: shot looking straight down from high above.

compositions.label: Low angle
compositions.def: the camera tilted up from below, making the subject loom.

compositions.label: Eye level
compositions.def: a straight-on, neutral view at the subject’s own height.

compositions.label: Dutch angle
compositions.def: the camera deliberately tilted so the horizon slants.

compositions.label: Over the shoulder
compositions.def: shot past a figure’s shoulder into the scene they face.

compositions.label: Shallow focus
compositions.def: a sharp subject against a soft, blurred background.

compositions.label: Deep focus
compositions.def: everything sharp from the near foreground to the far distance.

compositions.label: Layered depth
compositions.def: distinct foreground, middle and background layers building depth.

compositions.label: Sense of scale
compositions.def: a tiny figure set against something vast to show its size.

compositions.label: Silhouette
compositions.def: a dark shape outlined against a bright background.

compositions.label: Backlighting
compositions.def: light coming from behind the subject, rimming its edges.

compositions.label: Chiaroscuro
compositions.def: bold contrast of deep shadow and bright highlight.

compositions.label: High key
compositions.def: a bright, airy image of pale tones and few shadows.

compositions.label: Low key
compositions.def: a dark, moody image dominated by shadow.

compositions.label: Golden hour
compositions.def: warm, low, raking sunlight near sunrise or sunset.

compositions.label: Atmospheric haze
compositions.def: fog, mist or smoke softening the distance.

compositions.label: Motion blur
compositions.def: a moving subject streaked and blurred by the exposure.

compositions.label: Long exposure
compositions.def: a slow exposure smoothing water or trailing light.

compositions.label: Minimalism
compositions.def: a spare image reduced to one or two simple elements.

compositions.label: Juxtaposition
compositions.def: two contrasting things set side by side for effect.

compositions.label: Reflection
compositions.def: the subject mirrored in water, glass or a puddle.

compositions.label: Texture
compositions.def: a close study of surface — bark, stone, rust, weave.

compositions.label: Close-up
compositions.def: a tight, detailed view of a small subject or a face.

compositions.label: Wide shot
compositions.def: a sweeping view taking in the whole scene and setting.

compositions.label: Profile
compositions.def: a face or figure seen side-on in profile.

compositions.label: Group arrangement
compositions.def: several people posed and arranged together in the frame.

compositions.label: Environmental portrait
compositions.def: a person shown within the place that defines them.

compositions.label: Still life
compositions.def: objects deliberately arranged and lit on a surface.

compositions.label: Flat lay
compositions.def: objects laid out and shot straight down from above.
